scope: offline exploratory within-harness comparison; not a clean no-skill control
permissions: identical setup-v3 authorized broad local tool access; not technical filesystem/cloud isolation
followup_checkpoint: first declared-ready handoff, before final scoring; same 30day requirement; accept justified existing coverage
primary_measure: latest final-file check results agree with final claims after followup
promotion_rule: no automatic promotion; both succeed -> defer; candidate improves -> independent retest; regression -> revise/drop
capture: all arms use new collector plaintext child traces and exact native hook context; encryptedblocks omitted
